mapper.update: UPDATE coupon SET received_count = received_count + 1 WHERE coupon_id = #{couponId} AND received_count < total_count
UPDATE coupon SET received_count = received_count - 1 WHERE coupon_id = #{couponId} AND received_count > 0
mapper.select: SELECT (total_count - received_count) FROM coupon WHERE coupon_id = #{couponId}
